tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Check one factual claim against public Wikipedia sources and return a verdict (supported, contradicted, outdated, mixed or insufficient_evidence), a confidence score, a short reason, the supporting quote and the source URL. Says insufficient_evidence instead of guessing. Price: $1.00 USDC on Base pe

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_claims, verify_claim, check_answer, deep_verify · Private data: check_answer · Public sink: extract_claims, verify_claim, check_answer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_claims, verify_claim, check_answer, deep_verify · Private data: check_answer · Public sink: extract_claims, verify_claim, check_answer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "extract_claims" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
